subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives: 1 ✕ 7 =
stimulus: i. How old is Ameen when the war begins? (a) Sixteen (b) Eighteen (c) Seventeen (d) Nineteen ii. What is Sonabhan’s immediate reaction when Ameen says he will go to war? (a) She becomes silent (b) She cries quietly (c) She shrieks in surprise (d) She encourages him iii. What does Sonabhan feed the ducks in the morning? (a) Cooked rice and lentils (b) Rice husks mixed with water (c) Broken wheat (d) Bread crumbs iv. What is the name of Ameen's 12-week-old cockerel? (a) Lal (b) Piyu (c) Moti (d) Badal v. What does Ameen take to the bazaar to sell? (a) Rice, lentils, and oil (b) Mangoes and jackfruits (c) Chickens and ducks (d) Eggs, areca nuts, and a bottle gourd vi. What does Ameen avoid during breakfast? (a) Reading the newspaper (b) Feeding the ducks (c) Talking about the war (d) Any conversation with his mother vii. How far is the bazaar from Ameen’s home? (a) Half a mile (b) Two miles (c) About a mile (d) Three miles
